TLS v1.3 data structures, constants, and encode/decode APIs for wire format.

# Purpose
`fd_tls_proto.h` declares the TLS v1.3 wire-format data types and the encode and decode APIs used to convert them to and from serialized bytes. It defines packed headers, fixed-size fields, and custom structures for dynamic TLS items such as `ClientHello`, `ServerHello`, extensions, certificate data, and key share data. The file also defines TLS constants for versions, cipher suites, extension IDs, alert codes, message types, and certificate types. For static layouts such as `fd_tls_ext_hdr_t`, `fd_tls_msg_hdr_t`, and `fd_tls_finished_t`, it provides inline byte-swap and serialization helpers, while dynamic layouts use dedicated function prototypes.
